name: Web3Forms
description: A no-backend contact-form API: drop an HTML form on a static site and submissions land in email / webhooks without PHP or a server (company-stated). Founded Dec 2020, IN. Founder Surjith S M. Free forever (250 submissions/mo); paid for higher limits. Stack: Next.js, Tailwind, Vercel, Hetzner, Cloudflare, Paddle. DR 85.

mentions.evidence: ~$41.0k MRR, 2,971 active subscriptions, ~$44.3k L30, ~$305k all-time, founded Dec 2020, India. Last sync Oct 1, 2026. (Paddle, not Stripe — still payment-provider verified.)
mentions.indieAngle: Own one painful "I don't want a server" developer utility, meter submissions, keep the free tier as a funnel.

mentions.evidence: ~$41,988 MRR (+7.2% L30), 3,038 active subscriptions, ~$44,688 L30 (+0.4%), ~$133,499 last 3 months, ~$250,351 last 6 months, ~$318,476 all-time (L12 = AT on this profile), ~95% L30 profit margin. Revenue synced Oct 10, 2026 ~06:26 Warsaw (04:26 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Same product for EU privacy-sensitive static sites (Astro/Hugo on Cloudflare Pages): EU-hosted inbox, GDPR DPA, spam scoring, and a Zapier/Make + Notion/Sheets destination pack sold as "Form API for EU agencies" at €19–€49/mo.

whyItPrints: Contact forms are the original developer glue. ~3,038 subscriptions at ~$42k MRR with a 95% L30 profit margin is the dream indie shape: tiny infrastructure, SEO/docs-led acquisition, and a free tier that converts when a site gets real traffic. L30 is flat (+0.4%); MRR up +7.2%.
